evidence_task: Formative Entry 2 evidence opportunity for W1.4: retain learner work or tutor observation notes from the supplied independent task. Record support used and next teaching point. This is course evidence, not the awarding organisation's controlled assessment.
evidence_status: Formative/internal Brainy Elephant course evidence only. The regulated assessment is externally set by Gateway Qualifications and must be administered under the current approved-centre requirements.
criterion_focus: Use common adjectives to describe people, places and things to extend information and detail
learn: Teach the Entry 2 skill in the context of education and training. Model use common adjectives to describe people, places and things to extend information and detail. Draw attention to text/sentence/discourse features and require the learner to explain how they found or communicated meaning. Stage 2 emphasis: notices, leaflets, forms and schedules.
guided_practice: Work through a supplied Entry 2 example on education and training. Learner identifies or produces the required features, explains choices, and corrects one error after feedback. Reduce prompting as confidence increases.
tutor_review: Record achieved / developing / revisit against W1.4. Note independence, errors and support. Plan reinforcement where needed; do not treat course practice as the regulated assessment decision.
resources: Supplied Entry 2 lesson and independent resources relevant to education; learner evidence sheet; vocabulary support; writing materials or audio/role-play prompt as appropriate.
objectives: Develop Entry 2 English through education and training.
Use common adjectives to describe people, places and things to extend information and detail.
Complete supplied practice with increasing independence and review errors using an appropriate strategy.
key_language: and, but, because, first, then, yesterday, tomorrow, useful adjectives, capitals, full stops, question marks
learner_material: Write a short note or message about education and training. Include what happened, when or where it happened, and one reason or opinion. Join some ideas with and, but, or because. Check capital letters, full stops and question marks.
practice_tasks: Plan the purpose and reader before writing.
Choose the appropriate format.
Write simple and compound sentences.
Add relevant detail using familiar adjectives or time/place information.
Check capitals, punctuation and familiar spelling, then make corrections.
independent_task: Complete the supplied independent writing task. Use the requested format and details, then check and correct your own work before handing it to the tutor.
success_check: Performance is relevant to W1.4 at Entry 2.
Learner communicates or understands the main meaning plus relevant detail.
Tutor records independence/support and a clear next step.
independent_resource: Write a short note or message about education and training. Include what happened, when or where it happened, and one reason or opinion. Join some ideas with and, but, or because. Check capital letters, full stops and question marks.
